Alex: Morning — async standup for the roadmap items and launch prep. Quick: what I did / blockers / today
Maria: Did final pass on spec doc for routing fallback. Left 2 tiny UX questions inline. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4330
Chris: Reviewed 4330 — code looks good, left a comment about edge TTL. Will re-review after update.
Jamal: Infra blocker: dedicated test cluster hitting GPU quota in us-west-2, failing CI for canary perf tests. cc @Sean
Sean: On it — bumping quota and clearing queued jobs now. ETA ~35m.
Tanya: Prioritization Q: do we hold embedding-cache work for post-launch? Embedding team is asking for a cutoff today.
Alex: Routing + fallback is top priority for this launch. Embed cache can be deferred one sprint unless you see a hard blocker.
Maria: UX Qs: do we need a modal to explain fallback behavior or just an inline note? Sketch: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234
Chris: For the modal, keep it optional. My concern: modal adds an extra click on first use. Suggest inline with "Learn more" link.
Jamal: Quick note — smoke tests failing on PR 4321 because of new env var naming. Patch in 4322 fixes it.
Alex: Can reviewers pls prioritize PRs: 4322 (smoke fix) and 4330 (routing spec impl)? Tagging @Chris @Maria for 4330, @Sean for infra bits.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled at 12:30 UTC for service/redwood-runtime (canary-42) — tickets: #7843
Chris: I can take 4330 re-review after lunch.
Sean: Quota increased, CI queues cleared. Jamal — can you re-run the canary suite?
Jamal: Re-running now: `./scripts/run_canary.sh --suite=perf --region=us-west-2`
Maria: I'll finish UX review and sign off by 17:00 PT. If any blocker, ping me here.
Tanya: I'll update the roadmap board to reflect deferral of embed-cache and add a note for stakeholders.
Alex: Thanks — I'll put the launch checklist items in the shared doc and post the link here. Small ask: anyone able to do final smoke ownership at 11:45 PT?
Chris: I can own final smoke at 11:45.
Alex: Awesome. If anything urgent pops up, @here callout. Otherwise i'll compile notes and close this thread by EOD. :thumbsup:
